rows.grounds: name or designation referring to that which is pleasing to Indra; object of honor
indicates conformity with the previously established manner
compound denoting agrahāra grants and similar holdings included together
past passive participle indicating the state of being worshipped or honored

items.question: In what manner are Indrakānta and agrahāra holdings to be honored?
premises: Indrakānta is designated as an object of honor.
The honoring follows the previously established manner.
Agrahāra holdings and similar grants are included in this honor.
items.inference: Therefore Indrakānta together with agrahāra and related holdings is honored as before.
uncertainties: The precise referent of indrakāntaṃ in this ritual context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Indrakānta, as before, together with agrahāra and similar holdings, is to be honored.
